Teacher reference uses 192.168.0.121, mask 255.255.255.0, no gateway, and preferred DNS 192.168.0.121.
DNS-Win2025 is grouped inside the DNS folder in the Workstation Library. Keep Windows hostname DNS01.
In Workstation, open Edit → Virtual Network Editor. Click Change Settings to enable administrator editing.
Click Add Network and choose an unused VMnet2. Preserve the existing VMnet0, VMnet1, and VMnet8 settings.

Select Host-only. Set subnet IP to 192.168.0.0 and subnet mask to 255.255.255.0. Keep Connect a host virtual adapter to this network checked. Clear Use local DHCP service to distribute IP address to VMs.
The screenshot confirms the VMnet2 subnet and host-only settings, host adapter enabled and DHCP disabled. Click Apply → OK.

Open DNS-Win2025 → VM Settings → Network Adapter. Change NAT to Custom: Specific virtual network → VMnet2. Keep Connected and Connect at power on checked, then click OK. The screenshot shows NAT before this instruction; a post-change adapter screenshot is still needed to independently verify the attachment.
Inside DNS01, press Win+R, enter ncpa.cpl, open Ethernet0 Properties, select Internet Protocol Version 4 (TCP/IPv4), then click Properties.
Select Use the following IP address. Enter IP 192.168.0.121 and mask 255.255.255.0. Clear gateway. Set preferred DNS to 192.168.0.121 and leave alternate DNS blank.
The new IP and mask were correct and gateway blank, but preferred DNS still showed 192.168.23.2. Replace it with 192.168.0.121, then OK → Close.
Run ipconfig /all. The screenshot confirms hostname DNS01, DHCP Enabled: No, IPv4 192.168.0.121 (Preferred), mask 255.255.255.0, blank default gateway, and DNS server 192.168.0.121.
